Conducted user research, created personas, and ran usability testing to validate and iterate on product designs.
Collaborated with PMs and developers delivering well-documented Figma handoffs following platform design guidelines.
experience.desc: Independently led full product design cycles at KIBA Labs, from research and wireframes to high-fidelity UI and developer handoff.
